learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the physical mechanisms that govern semiconductor devices
Physical-mathematical understanding of basic circuits and devices: (a) operational amplifiers; (2) diodes; (3) bipolar junction transistors (BJTs) and (4) field effect transitors (MOSFETs).
Design and analysis of small amplifiers and other simple circuits

teaching_methods: Theoretical classes using visual aids with detailed exposition of the concepts, principles and fundamental theories and the resolution of conventional exercises for consolidation of knowledge.
Laboratory weekly classes with experimental works or practical classes related with the topics covered in the theoretical-practical classes.
bibliography: Sedra & Smith- Microlelectronic Circuits, Oxford University Press. (2016 ou outras edições)
Malvino, Albert Paul, Electronic Principles, Mc Graw Hill, 8th edition , 2015.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
